papers.title: The Asymmetric Maximum Margin Bias of Quasi-Homogeneous Neural Networks
papers.findings: Definition3.1 heterogeneous diagonal scaling; Theorem4.1 assumes A1-A7 including gradient flow, strong separability, full Lambda-normalized parameter convergence and conditional separability. AppendixH explicitly covers multiclass CE with A10 threshold log(2)/n. AppendixB proper-grading discussion addresses nonunique Lambda; cascading minimization is Conjecture5.1.
papers.limits: Listed setup, theorem, proof sketch, AppendixB examples/definitions and AppendixH selected derivation read. Main AppendixE proof and B consistency proof beyond p18 not fully read; no independent theorem audit or experiments/code reproduction. First-order KKT is not global optimality or observed robustness/generalization.

papers.title: Implicit Bias of Gradient Descent for Non-Homogeneous Deep Networks
papers.findings: Definition1 near-M homogeneity requires global polynomial bounds on output AND gradient, plus Euler residual. GF results add strong low-risk threshold; KKT result adds weak-homogeneous-gradient assumption. GD section has explicit vanilla full-loss GD plus stronger Hessian/low-risk conditions. p7 explicitly excludes normalization/softmax-attention from provided block calculus.
papers.limits: Selected main-body sections only; p1-2 and p4/8-9 scoped subsections, not whole proofs. Appendix proofs, experiments and code not audited. Original statement about softmax does not itself prove failure for nonlinear normalized Born attention; native witness separately specifies its scope.
